variables.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS
variables.description: Comma-separated IP ranges of trusted reverse proxies. Only requests from these peers may use X-Forwarded-For for per-client limits. Configure the proxy to append or replace that header.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Private random key (at least 32 characters) used to sign admin session cookies. Keep stable across restarts.

variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username used to sign in to the post editor at /admin.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Private password used to sign in to the post editor. Use a long, unique value.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: HTTP listening port. Defaults to 8818 for local runs and the Uppr Docker deployment.

variables.name: EGATE_HOST
variables.description: Base URL of the egate service for contact email notifications. Set with all other EGATE settings.

variables.name: EGATE_API_KEY
variables.description: Private app key registered in egate; never expose to browsers.

variables.name: EGATE_SENDER_EMAIL
variables.description: Verified sender address used for contact notifications.
